title: Injectivity of the localized normalization stalk map
statement: Let X be locally Noetherian, U an open, p:P -> U finite etale, x a normalization point outside U, and O_{X,s} a domain and DVR. Then the induced map from the base stalk to the normalization stalk is injective.

proof.text: Write f = p composed with the open immersion U -> X and n = f.fromNormalization. Etaleness of p and flatness of the open immersion make f flat. To prove injectivity, take a germ r in the kernel of n.stalkMap x and represent it by a section s on V around n(x). Mathlib Scheme.exists_le_and_germ_injective (SpreadingOut.lean, using local Noetherianity) gives an affine B contained in V with injective germ map at n(x). Restrict s to a section t on B. Since the stalk at n(x) is a domain, Function.Injective.isDomain makes Gamma(X,B) a domain.

Naturality of germs and germ_res_apply identify r with the germ of t and show that n.app B t has zero germ at x. The presheaf germ_eq lemma gives an open W containing x on which this section is zero. Mathlib Hom.toNormalization is dominant, so its denseRange.exists_mem_open supplies z in P whose image in the normalization belongs to W. The composite toNormalization followed by n is f. Naturality of germs and Hom.stalkMap_comp therefore show that f.app B t has zero germ at z. The dependent membership transport is explicit in H and H′ in the Lean proof.

The stalk map of f at z is flat (Flat.stalkMap) and local, hence faithfully flat by Module.FaithfullyFlat.of_flat_of_isLocalHom, and injective by FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective. Consequently t has zero germ at f(z). The affine stalk at f(z) is a localization of the domain Gamma(X,B) at its prime ideal (IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk). Its germ map is injective by IsLocalization.injective and Ideal.primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors, so t = 0 and r = 0. RingHom.ker_eq_bot_iff_eq_zero finishes injectivity. These are direct applications of proved Mathlib declarations; the complete Lean proof uses no postponed lemma. The DVR and boundary assumptions are unnecessary for this argument, but the theorem signature is preserved.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_dvr_normalization_stalkMap_injective
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (U : X.Opens)
    {P : Scheme.{u}} (p : P ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite p] (hetale : Etale p)
    (x : (p ≫ U.ι).normalization)
    (hs : (p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x ∉ U)
    [IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x))]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing (X.presheaf.stalk ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization x))] :
    Function.Injective ((p ≫ U.ι).fromNormalization.stalkMap x).hom
